name: generic-phone-game-menu-accessibility
description: Verify every actually visible legacy GameMenu tab and control fits text and meets a 44 px target on a generic 740x360 landscape phone.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local name='PunchWall Generic Phone 740x360' local id for _,candidate in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(candidate).Name==name then id=candidate break end end local config={Name=name,Width=740,Height=360,PixelDensity=320,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,config) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(config) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetOrientationAsync(Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeLeft) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local resolution=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id,width=resolution.X,height=resolution.Y})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local menu=g.GameMenu local pages={'Fists','Pets','Honor','Tasks','Settings'} local results={} local all=true local totalSmall,totalBadText=0,0 local minTarget=math.huge local function effectiveVisible(node) local current=node while current and current~=g do if current:IsA('GuiObject') and not current.Visible then return false end current=current.Parent end return true end local function clippedVisible(node) if not effectiveVisible(node) or node.AbsoluteSize.X<=0 or node.AbsoluteSize.Y<=0 then return false end local p,s=node.AbsolutePosition,node.AbsoluteSize local current=node.Parent while current and current~=g do if current:IsA('GuiObject') and current.ClipsDescendants then local cp,cs=current.AbsolutePosition,current.AbsoluteSize if p.X+s.X<=cp.X or p.X>=cp.X+cs.X or p.Y+s.Y<=cp.Y or p.Y>=cp.Y+cs.Y then return false end end current=current.Parent end return true end for _,page in ipairs(pages) do g:SetAttribute('AutomationTab',page) task.wait(.35) local buttons,small,badText=0,0,0 local smallest=math.huge for _,node in ipairs(menu:GetDescendants()) do if node:IsA('GuiButton') and clippedVisible(node) and node.Active then buttons+=1 local target=math.min(node.AbsoluteSize.X,node.AbsoluteSize.Y) smallest=math.min(smallest,target) if target<44 then small+=1 end elseif (node:IsA('TextLabel') or node:IsA('TextButton')) and clippedVisible(node) and node.Text~='' and not node.TextFits then badText+=1 end end local valid=buttons>0 and small==0 and badText==0 all=all and valid totalSmall+=small totalBadText+=badText minTarget=math.min(minTarget,smallest) results[page]={valid=valid,buttons=buttons,small=small,badText=badText,minTarget=smallest==math.huge and 0 or smallest} end return H:JSONEncode({valid=all,totalSmall=totalSmall,totalBadText=totalBadText,minTarget=minTarget==math.huge and 0 or minTarget,viewport=tostring(workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize),pages=results})

steps.label: all generic-phone menu controls meet 44 px and visible text fits

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if info.Name=='PunchWall Generic Phone 740x360' and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return {default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed}

steps.label: restore default simulator and remove test device

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) return true
